notes.title: Playtest final version update!
notes.notes:
A week of testing is coming to an end! We received a lot of bug feedback during this period... but fortunately, we have fixed all of them!
And we have also updated several optimizations!
But considering that Playtest is not the final version, and we have received a lot of optimization suggestions from players, we will not explain them one by one here. Please look forward to our DEMO version!
This will also be the last update of Playtest (if there are no serious bugs), and I am very grateful to every player who has experienced it!
Let's see you in the DEMO version!
